title: Canopy Training Observation Record
purpose: Create comparable before/after records for structural training, pruning, trellising, and defoliation so treatment decisions can be evaluated rather than remembered anecdotally.
interpretationRules: Use the same measurement locations and instruments before and after treatment when possible.
Do not compare yield values produced with different harvest, drying, trimming, or normalization methods.
Record cultivar, density, environment, and developmental stage because architecture responses are context-dependent.
A visually open canopy is not by itself evidence of improved crop performance.
